notes.title: The Stairway 7 v1.0.6 - More Achievments, New Language, Bug Fixes & More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Hope you are all doing well! Thank you again for your awesome feedbacks, keep them coming! I will do my best in improving the game with all your help. 

The new update includes new achievements with the total of 12, more bug fixes and also added an new language option. One achievement have been added to 'Survival mode' which unlocks if you complete the whole game without dying. Are you one of the brave few to be up for the challenge? 

[list]
[*] Added additional achievements in the game.
[*] One achievement in now related to the Survival mode. Can you be one of the few to get it?
[*] Fixed an issue where the sounds could be heard from other floor levels.
[*] Fixed the issue where red light was showing through some floor levels.
[*] Decreased the volume of the jumpscares in general.
[*] Added faster speed to the sprint of the player.
[*] Added more stamina to the player.
[*] Updated some audio and sound clips.
[*] Medicine is now more visible in certain areas.
[*] All changes have been made to both modes.
[*] Added new language 'Italian' which can now be selected in the settings.
[*] Fixed a couple of issues and other minor bugs.
[/list]

I do have many plans depending on how well the community wants them, such as randomized levels, more penalties, different anomalies and much more.

If you like, feel free to also join the discord server, will be more then happy to have a chat there as well! Still small but we are a cool little growing community! :)

Discord Link: https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK

Thank you everyone and hope you have a great day all!

notes.title: The Stairway 7 v1.0.5 - Achievments, Bug Fixes, Accessibility & More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Hope you are all doing well! I wish to firstly thank you all for your support and for playing the game. All your feedback, suggestions and criticism means so much to me to help me in improving the game!

[b]The first update is now LIVE! [/b] It includes achievements, bug fixes and some other accessibility options thanks to the kind feedback of you guys.

[list]
[*] Added achievements in the game as requested.
[*] Added an accessibility option in the settings where you can switch OFF the VHS filter effect.
[*] Added an accessibility option in the settings where you can turn off the floor level number indicators.
[*] Fixed the bug where some anomaly were bugged, such as spawning two heads on the mannequin.
[*] Increased the volume of when you detect and remove an anomaly.
[*] Added an accessibility option in the settings where you can turn off the floor level number indicators.
[*] Added an accessibility option in the settings where you can turn off the floor level number indicators.
[*] Updated some audio and sound clips.
[*] All changes have been made to both modes.
[*] Fixed a couple of issues and other minor bugs.
[/list]

Just a reminder that the [b]achievements can only be unlocked in the normal mode, and not in survival mode. [/b] Survival mode also do NOT contain any floor level indicators in the game, so it will be harder to distinguish on which floor level you are, making you feel more lost. 

If you like, feel free to also join the discord server, will be more then happy to have a chat there as well! Still small but we are a cool little community haha :)

Discord Link: https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK

Thank you everyone and hope you have a great day all!

notes.title: New indie horror game is PT with a cat, and I'm scared to touch it
notes.notes:
I love cats, but as much as they can be an endless source of comfort they're also creepy little guys sometimes. They bring you half-caught prey to train you in the art of the hunt, they're often seemingly indifferent to bizarre situations around them, and they might even eat you if left without other food sources after your untimely passing. Suffice to say, then, that I'm not sure if the presence of a cat in the new PT-style indie horror game The Stairway 7 is a good or bad thing - but it's certainly got me curious.
